name: Ubicloud Postgres

evidence.sql: C02: managed SQL database is the primary type; D01: native PostgreSQL 16, 17 and 18
evidence.vector: V01: pgvector 0.8.2 supported on managed PostgreSQL

line: Managed PostgreSQL with backups, point-in-time recovery, replicas and extensions.

free.text: No hosted free tier; Hobby-1 $19.54/mo; no idle pause or deletion rule

cells.regions: 3 metal regions; AWS; Google Cloud preview

sql.math: $19.54 is the advertised monthly resource budget. The exact per-minute bill, 5 GB of egress and add-ons are not yet confirmed.
The same $19.54 advertised budget applies while idle. The exact per-minute bill and any extra costs are not yet confirmed.

files.math: Postgres backups are not an app object storage service.

jobs.math: pg_cron uses database capacity. No price per job or matching worker size is published.
